_about: Sentence pools for the multi-turn test dialogues (v1). Author-written Chinese. tune and heldout pools share no sentence, except that very short backchannel/filler words are listed separately per split and may coincide in spirit. reply=true means the assistant should answer.

question.note: a real question to the assistant

request.note: an instruction or request to the assistant

side_talk.note: the user talks to someone else nearby

filler.note: hesitation or non-lexical sound, no content
